risks.proof: Photo of brand logo or nameplate on panel frame or junction box.

risks.risk: Condition/output performance not demonstrated; panels could be cracked, delaminated, or underperforming despite cosmetic appearance.
risks.proof: Photo/video of panel connected to a multimeter or charge controller showing actual voltage/current output in sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified working, i.e. at the lowest comparable tier

risks.if_unproven: treat listing as panels-only; disregard battery claim for pricing

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating label on the back of each panel (watts, voltage, cell count).
Photo of any brand name/logo on the panel frame or junction box.
Photo or short video of the panel's output reading on a multimeter/charge controller in daylight.
Clarification and separate photo of the battery being described in the text, if it is part of this sale.
response.reason: The photo shows unbranded, unlabeled solar panels with no visible wattage, while the seller's text describes an unrelated battery claim, so neither the item's specs nor its match to the text can be confirmed and no worst-case price tier can be selected without a wattage/label shot.
